name: personal-agentic-workbench
description: Reusable OpenCode-native personal agentic orchestration and workflow system.

agents.name: orchestrator
agents.description: Coordinates multi-agent orchestration workflows, decomposes tasks, delegates to specialists, enforces approval gates, and produces final execution summaries.

agents.name: researcher
agents.description: Investigates codebases and documentation, researches technical solutions, compares implementation approaches, and produces evidence-based research reports.

agents.name: planner
agents.description: Converts requirements into implementation plans, identifies affected files and systems, defines acceptance criteria, and breaks work into independently verifiable stages.

agents.name: developer
agents.description: Implements approved changes following project conventions, creates isolated branches, writes maintainable code, and avoids unrelated modifications.

agents.name: qa-engineer
agents.description: Runs relevant tests, validates expected behaviour, detects regressions, verifies builds and configurations, and produces test evidence.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Independently inspects implementation changes, reviews security architecture and maintainability, identifies regressions and incomplete requirements, and verifies acceptance criteria.
